item.title: Forecasting for a Sustainable Future: Energy Systems, Climate Risks, Environmental Governance, Financial Markets and Societal Resilience
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on advancing forecasting methodologies to address critical sustainability challenges. The issue brings together research on predicting energy system transitions, assessing climate-related risks, modeling environmental governance outcomes, analyzing financial market sustainability dimensions, and forecasting factors that enhance societal resilience. The call welcomes contributions that apply forecasting techniques to understand and navigate the interconnected environmental, financial, and social systems shaping our sustainable future.

Appel publié par Journal of Forecasting. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Energy systems forecasting
  • Climate risk assessment and prediction
  • Environmental governance and policy forecasting
  • Financial markets sustainability
  • Societal resilience forecasting
  • Integration of forecasting methods for sustainability challenges
